cells.gaps: No source found names a second international fibre route fully in service. Maroc Telecom, Moov Mauritel's catalogue and its Director General on 1 May 2026 say the West Africa Cable at Nouadhibou is in operation (MRT-010, MRT-011, MRT-013), but Ecofin on 5 May 2026 says ACE is still the single system with no fully operational alternative (MRT-001, MRT-009); the newer stands.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-12: Moov Mauritel's Director General said on 1 May 2026 that the West Africa cable is in operation (MRT-013), but Ecofin's 5 May 2026 reports, the newer, still give ACE as the one route in service, so stage 2.
